bootstrap_order.finding: Proper initialization sequence in frontend (AuthGuard) and API routes. Supabase client initialized before routes. However, frontend permits missing Supabase (graceful fallback for local dev) which masks config issues in CI/staging.

graceful_shutdown.finding: No process.on('SIGTERM') or process.on('SIGINT') handlers found. Vercel serverless manages termination automatically (acceptable for current deployment), but long-running deployments would require shutdown handlers.
graceful_shutdown.recommendation: Add SIGTERM/SIGINT handlers if moving to VM/Kubernetes. Document Vercel-specific lifecycle management.

resource_cleanup.finding: No explicit resource cleanup. Supabase client is a singleton (src/dashboard/lib/supabase.js:12-14) never explicitly closed. No database connection pooling management.
resource_cleanup.recommendation: Add cleanup logic on shutdown: call supabase.auth.signOut(), verify no lingering subscriptions.

signal_handling.finding: No signal handlers (SIGTERM, SIGINT, SIGHUP) detected outside node_modules. Vercel functions do not receive direct signals, but long-running deployments require this.
signal_handling.recommendation: Add signal handlers for long-running deployments. Not critical for Vercel serverless.

probes.finding: No /health or /ready endpoints. supabase-status.js is a data endpoint, not a health probe. Vercel serverless does not require probes, but Kubernetes/load balancers cannot detect readiness.
probes.recommendation: Add /api/health (liveness) and /api/ready (readiness) endpoints. Lightweight checks suitable for monitoring and orchestration.

startup_config_validation.finding: Inconsistent validation: frontend gracefully degrades when Supabase missing (local dev permissive), API routes fail-fast in some endpoints (supabase-messages.js:48-50, create-world.js:32-34) and graceful in others (haiku-chat.js:411-415). Prebuild script exits gracefully if AOM-EA missing (generate-briefs-index.js:38-40). No centralized startup config validation.
startup_config_validation.recommendation: Create api/_lib/validateConfig.js with fail-fast pattern. Call in startup route or middleware. Update frontend AuthGuard to fail-fast in production (NODE_ENV check).

topGaps.title: No graceful shutdown handlers
topGaps.impact: Requests in-flight during SIGTERM are aborted; Supabase connections close ungracefully.
topGaps.currentState: Vercel auto-terminates (acceptable for serverless), but long-running deployments need this.

topGaps.title: No health/ready probe endpoints
topGaps.impact: Load balancers and orchestrators cannot detect readiness or liveness.
topGaps.currentState: Not critical for Vercel, but required for Kubernetes/auto-scaling.

topGaps.title: Inconsistent config validation
topGaps.impact: Frontend permits missing Supabase (masks issues in CI/staging). API routes inconsistently fail-fast vs. graceful degrade.
topGaps.currentState: No centralized startup check; validation scattered across endpoints.

topGaps.title: No signal handlers
topGaps.impact: Process terminates abruptly on SIGTERM/SIGINT; no opportunity for cleanup.
topGaps.currentState: Not critical for Vercel serverless, but required for VM/Kubernetes.

topGaps.title: Frontend gracefully falls back when Supabase missing
topGaps.impact: Intentional for local dev, but masks config issues in staging/CI environments.

productionReadiness.notes: Vercel serverless handles shutdown/termination automatically, so HIGH gaps are acceptable for current deployment. If Corner moves to long-running VM or Kubernetes, all HIGH items must be addressed. Probes are recommended even for Vercel (monitoring + visibility).

implementationEffort.immediate: S (1-2 hours: add probe endpoints + centralized config validation)
implementationEffort.shortTerm: M (4-6 hours: add signal handlers + resource cleanup if moving off Vercel)
implementationEffort.longTerm: M (Kubernetes lifecycle support if deployment target changes)
